descriptionHtml:
Case priority: P1 · our extension of a stated behaviour · ours: rapid taps.

Approach · TC-21 Hospital vs. Nursing-Home Context Switch · S12 Rapid Nursing Home → Hospital → Nursing Home taps: no stale or mixed list

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U6 No data or template leakage between Hospital and Nursing Home. This covers lists, charts, the template picker, custom templates, account-wide screens (search, dashboard counts, Task Export, Inbox, mu … (UAT TC-21; TFA-92599 AC 5) — gate: blocked: TFA-92599 in progress

Test design technique: Error guessing (error-guessing) — Go straight for the places most likely to break (failures, double clicks, two tabs, a wrong clock, injected instructions).

Given Hospital list open, fixture patients

When On a real phone, tap Nursing Home, Hospital and Nursing Home as fast as possible; also a fast mouse sequence on desktop web

Then The final list is the Nursing Home list with only the resident, no mixed rows from the previous context, and the saved setting is Nursing Home

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): A person checks the final screen. The 2026-10-10 agent Pass is not evidence: the agent acts one MCP call at a time, and each click waits for a new snapshot, so the race never happens.

Where it ran: local newspec-c (new Playwright specs); test method PW · Playwright script; lane planned in the matrix: manual (manual)

S12 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-21.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.
